title: Welcome to the desk
body:
This is where the morning brief lands each day before 08:00.

For now, three things matter before 14 October:
1. Work through the handover checklist with her. Five items are marked Must.
2. Confirm whether the EMP501 interim is filed. It is due 30 October, two weeks into your cover.
3. Get bank release rights and eFiling access in place, so nothing waits on her once she is off.

Anything with a Confirm with SOP tag is my best guess until I see her SOP.
